changelog: Virtual TV 2.0.1.3 test build hardens Standard TV Play from Beginning on Jellyfin Android phone/tablet and Android TV. It captures the request-time Android session/device, waits for the Record response/client refresh, confirms the concrete library item actually starts, and safely re-resolves/retries the active media-control controller when needed. No Standard TV stream, scheduling, Personalized TV or Guide geometry code is changed.
